assertions.name: no_guarded_off_candidates
assertions.unit: boolean (1.0 = no script contains guarded-off shapes)
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every canonical-witness consumer runs unconditionally (or behind a gate the watcher has explicitly approved).

description: I3 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: scripts that contain `if False:` / `if 0:` blocks, env-var-defaulting-to-off gates, or explicit `# DEAD`/`# DISABLED`/`# LEGACY` markers where a canonical-witness consumer may have been disabled.  Candidates only — review the per-line context to confirm the block actually wraps a canonical-path call (vs being a debug toggle / leftover scaffolding).
